articles.title: Euroseeds 2026 Congress: Europe’s seed sector meets in Valencia
articles.summary: The Euroseeds Congress will bring the European seed sector to Valencia from 25–28 October 2026 for crop-section meetings, innovation and industry exchange.
articles.author: SeedTrade Editorial

content.heading: Official event information
content.body: Euroseeds lists its 2026 Congress for 25–28 October at the Valencia Conference Centre in Valencia, Spain. The programme covers the sector’s crop sections, innovation and opportunities for professional exchange.

content.heading: Programme relevance
content.body: The official programme includes Forages & Grasses, Cereals & Pulses, Oil & Fibre, Vegetables & Ornamentals, Maize & Sorghum and Potatoes, alongside InnovAction and NextGen activities.

content.heading: Why it matters
content.body: For European seed-market participants, the congress offers a concentrated setting to follow sector priorities, regulatory and industry discussions, innovation, and international commercial relationships. This paragraph is SeedTrade editorial analysis, not an official Euroseeds statement.

content.heading: Registration
content.body: Registration and eligibility conditions are maintained by Euroseeds. Prospective participants should use the official congress website for current programme, venue and registration information.

articles.title: INTERPOM 2026: a view across Europe’s potato value chain
articles.summary: INTERPOM will bring the professional potato chain to Kortrijk Xpo from 29 November to 1 December 2026, with seed potatoes, cultivation, storage, technology, processing and trade represented.
articles.author: SeedTrade Editorial

content.heading: Official event information
content.body: INTERPOM lists its 23rd edition for 29 November–1 December 2026 at Kortrijk Xpo in Belgium. The organiser’s current event profile reports 332 exhibitors from 15 countries, 24,000 visitors from 60 countries and 35,000 square metres of exhibition space.

content.heading: Seed potato and production relevance
content.body: The official exhibitor directory includes seeds, cultivation and storage alongside mechanisation, processing, packaging, marketing, research and transport. This breadth makes the event relevant across the seed-potato, growing, storage and downstream value chain.

content.heading: Why it matters
content.body: For SeedTrade users, the event is a practical point for observing how propagation material, crop conditions, storage, processing demand and commercial logistics interact. This is SeedTrade editorial analysis and does not constitute a Market Signal or a forecast.

content.heading: Practical control
content.body: Dates, opening times, exhibitors and access conditions can change. Visitors should verify the latest information and registration conditions on the official INTERPOM website before making arrangements.

articles.title: Lagrenas and contract seed multiplication opportunities in Lithuania
articles.summary: A transparent Partner Insight on how a Lithuanian cooperative network could help European seed companies identify and coordinate suitable multiplication farms.
articles.author: SeedTrade Partner Insights
articles.partner_disclosure: This Partner Insight includes information supplied by Lagrenas. Partner-provided claims are identified and are not treated as independent SeedTrade market evidence.

content.heading: Cooperative network
content.body: Lagrenas publicly describes a Lithuanian network of seven agricultural cooperatives and 630 members, supporting collective purchasing, advice, experience sharing, product trials and market analysis.

content.heading: Potential cooperation model
content.body: A European seed company could work through Lagrenas coordination to identify suitable cooperative or member farms for a contract seed-multiplication project in Lithuania. Any capacity, technical, certification and commercial terms would require project-specific verification.

content.heading: Partner-provided capabilities
content.body: Lagrenas states that its network includes experienced farmers with modern agricultural equipment and developed agricultural infrastructure. Potential crops identified by the partner include flax or linseed, hemp, vetch species, caraway, clovers and other suitable seed crops.

content.heading: Commercial boundaries
content.body: No production hectares, volumes, customers, contracts, certification status, equipment inventory, completed projects, yields or commercial results are asserted here. Suitability and capacity are not guaranteed.

claims.claim: Collective purchasing, advice, experience sharing, trials and market analysis
Experienced farmers, modern equipment and developed infrastructure

content.body: Ein europäisches Saatgutunternehmen könnte über die Koordination von Lagrenas geeignete Genossenschafts- oder Mitgliedsbetriebe für ein vertragliches Saatgutvermehrungsprojekt in Litauen identifizieren. content.body: Lagrenas décrit publiquement un réseau lituanien de sept coopératives agricoles et de 630 membres, favorisant les achats collectifs, le conseil, le partage d’expérience, les essais de produits et l’analyse de marché.

content.heading: Modèle de coopération possible
content.body: Une entreprise semencière européenne pourrait s’appuyer sur la coordination de Lagrenas pour identifier des exploitations coopératives ou membres adaptées à un projet de multiplication de semences sous contrat en Lituanie. Toute capacité et toute condition technique, de certification ou commerciale nécessiteraient une vérification propre au projet.

Les cultures possibles citées par le partenaire comprennent le lin textile ou oléagineux, le chanvre, des espèces de vesces, le carvi, les trèfles et d’autres cultures semencières adaptées.
